'''Arosh''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as an apprentice to [[Darth Hadra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
